# MDEx

> An extensible Markdown library for Elixir, powered by a Rust parser, with Phoenix LiveView integration.

## Documentation

- [Installation and usage](https://hexdocs.pm/mdex/MDEx.html#module-installation): Mix dependencies, Igniter setup, and conversion examples.
- [API reference](https://hexdocs.pm/mdex/MDEx.html): Parsing, rendering, sigils, and output formats.
- [Phoenix LiveView](https://hexdocs.pm/mdex/phoenix_live_view_heex.html): Markdown templates with HEEx components and assigns.
- [Streaming](https://hexdocs.pm/mdex/streaming.html): Incremental Markdown processing for HTTP responses and LiveView.
- [Document API](https://hexdocs.pm/mdex/MDEx.Document.html): AST traversal, transformation, and document operations.
- [Syntax highlighting](https://hexdocs.pm/mdex/syntax_highlight.html): Lumis and Syntect configuration.
- [Plugins](https://hexdocs.pm/mdex/plugins.html): Extending the document pipeline.
- [Safety](https://hexdocs.pm/mdex/safety.html): Raw HTML, escaping, and sanitization options.
- [Code block decorators](https://hexdocs.pm/mdex/code_block_decorators-2.html): Per-block themes, highlighted lines, and CSS classes.

## Project

- [Markdown overview](https://mdelixir.dev/index.md): Capabilities, installation, and examples.
- [Hex package](https://hex.pm/packages/mdex): Releases and dependencies.
- [Source code](https://github.com/leandrocp/mdex): Implementation, issues, and contributions.

## Agent resources

- [Discovery API](https://mdelixir.dev/api.md): Public API and MCP endpoints.
- [Access](https://mdelixir.dev/auth.md): Anonymous access without credentials.
